page.layout: One printed title page, centred, with several lines of large and small type. The scan shows heavy mirrored show-through from the reverse, so most lines are unreadable. A library stamp and manuscript marks sit over the text and are left out.
page.notes: The scan is mirrored: the printed title is seen through the paper from the reverse, and the visible letters are reversed. Only a few words are reliable, and every [?] is a guess. The line counts for the illegible lines are estimates. The library stamp (MVSEVM BRITANNICVM), the handwritten "XI" and "Z.e", and the small "2" at the right edge are not printed and are left out. The large lower-left and right edge marks are stains and the edge of the neighbouring page. No running head, page number, catchword or signature is visible.
